data.label: Linux Internals & Bash Automation
data.description: Master the Linux filesystem hierarchy, process management (systemd, ps, top), file permissions, SSH keys, pipes, and Bash scripting.
data.codeSnippet:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Server Health Check Script
set -euo pipefail
DISK_USAGE=$(df -h / | awk 'NR==2 {print $5}')
MEM_FREE=$(free -m | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')
echo "Disk: $DISK_USAGE | Free RAM: ${MEM_FREE}MB"

data.label: CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub Actions)
data.description: Automate build, test, and release workflows using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI. Manage secrets, artifacts, and test runners.
data.codeSnippet:
name: CI Pipeline
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: 20 }
      - run: npm ci && npm test

data.label: Containerization (Docker)
data.description: Build OCI compliant container images, minimize layer sizes with multi-stage builds, configure volume mounts, and orchestrate with Docker Compose.
data.codeSnippet:
version: '3.8'
services:
  web:
    build: .
    ports: ["3000:3000"]
    environment: [DATABASE_URL=postgres://db:5432/app]
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
volumes: { pgdata: }

data.label: Container Orchestration (Kubernetes)
data.description: Deploy resilient microservices with Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress controllers, ConfigMaps, and horizontal pod autoscalers (HPA).
data.codeSnippet:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api-service
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: api }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: api } }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: nocturnal/api:v1
          ports: [{ containerPort: 8080 }]

data.label: DevSecOps, Secrets & Vulnerability Scanning
data.description: Shift security left: container image vulnerability scanning with Trivy, automated SAST/DAST pipelines, Vault dynamic secrets injection, and SLSA supply chain provenance.
data.codeSnippet:
# Run Trivy security scanner on container image in CI
trivy image \
  --severity HIGH,CRITICAL \
  --exit-code 1 \
  --ignore-unfixed \
  nocturnal/api:latest

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
